scope: Read-only independent full mathematical alignment review of all six stages, complete reference/contract/rubric, all seven source modules and author mapping. Compiler evidence is separate; no human approval or candidate model result is asserted.

items.analysis: The algebraic quotient receives exactly the observation norm induced by its actual range equivalence. E has only AddCommGroup and Module; no norm or topology is assumed. The closed recovery is an actual continuous linear map, with exact Pythagoras, optimum uniqueness, existence of original minimizers and the complete kernel coset.

The hypothesis uses the actual conditionally complete real iInf of squared residuals, which is proved equal to the projection residual squared. The state estimate separates epsilon from delta. The scalar identity-observation example verifies the two residual conditions and its actual quotient-state error equals epsilon+delta. Setting one parameter to zero certifies sharpness of each coefficient.

Actual UniformSpace.Completion, dense isometry extension, realization range and uniqueness are proved without imposing extra structure on E. An additional actual equivalence handles any supplied completion. The recovery map is linear and 1-Lipschitz; actual original iInf and all original fibers are identified, and the completed noise estimate is proved from the true iInf.

The counterexample is actual lp(N,R,2), with a bounded weighted diagonal operator, injectivity, dense range via finite-support sums, a summable explicit target and proof that its only formal preimage would be the nonsummable constant sequence. Actual infimum zero and nonattainment are proved.

Arbitrary monotone finite-dimensional subspaces satisfy strong convergence under density. Density is represented by closure of their submodule supremum, equivalent to closure of the union for a monotone family. Every proper nested stage has true projection-difference norm exactly 1; operator-norm convergence iff some actual stage equals Z is proved. Native lp coordinate subspaces instantiate every premise and give both strong convergence and constant norm gap.

The real Hilbert hypotheses first appear where the adjoint is used. Coercivity constructs the actual continuous inverse of A* A+lambda I. The objective expansion proves existence and uniqueness. Both limits use the genuine punctured right neighborhood filter at zero. Actual variational estimates and closure of the adjoint range prove strong convergence to the orthogonal minimum-norm representative; continuous observations prove the converse. No desired limit is assumed as a certificate.
